title: [NSW] 25kWh Solar Battery + 6.6kW Solar Panel $7,999 @ Aus Solar Energy Group
body:
Deal: [NSW] 25kWh Solar Battery + 6.6kW Solar Panel $7,999 @ Aus Solar Energy Group

[BatmanAU] Isnt this a better deal?
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/968313
[AusSolar] our one is $1000 cheaper.
our 30kwh package is $7499 $500 cheaper.
[tunzafun001] There system is also available for the $1000 vpp rebate.
So the Fox ESS is 6kwh bigger (31kwh - 25% bigger) and the same price $6999 after rebate.
Your deal is good, there deal is 25% better.
Keep em coming though.
[Lucille Bluth] 3 Hours Free Power Use &Charge 11am-2pm
Keyword title spamming at its finest.
Pay $7999 now and Receive VPP $1000 credit after 3 months.
So it's $7999 upfront, not $6999.
[AusSolar] You will get 3 Hours Free Power Use &Charge 11am-2pm, it's true offer.
Some rebate will take time to apply and receive, not instanly recieved. but you will receive it.
[Lucille Bluth] Every electricity company now offers a plan with three hours free in NSW. Solar Sharer Offer . There is nothing special with what you are offering that is unique.
[AusSolar] Some clients don't know how to compare and choose. we create this bundle package that we seen it's the best value, to help them to apply and switch , make it easier.
[Lucille Bluth] @AusSolar: Neg for false advertising in the title. Actual price buried in a wall of text to catch people out to make the deal appear better than competitor deals.
[AusSolar] @Lucille Bluth: It's different product different model, couldn't compare that way. for the same specs we can do better price for them as well.
[BatmanAU] OVO do 4 hours for free, then $0.06 for the 5th hour.
[AusSolar] @BatmanAU: But OVO doesn't give $1000 extra rebate. It's not locked in contract you can switch to anyother plan after receive the $1000.
But could you give more details how to get OVO 5th hours for $0.06/kwh rate ? we can recommend that to others as well.
[BatmanAU] @AusSolar: Not talking about $1000, just giving general comment to Lucille. Depends which state, off peak is 5 hours, included is the 4 free
[b0nd] The cost is $7999 - this post is pretty much marketing, no deal TBH
[AusSolar] Pay $7999 now and Receive VPP $1000 credit after 3 months.
Total System only $6999
[b0nd] I hope you’re next post won’t say “Sun rays $0” 😂
[AusSolar] if you already have solar panel and battery, we can also help to you get $1000 extra rebate, free service.
contact us if you need it.
[tunzafun001] @AusSolar: Does the 3month vpp apply to my Growatt batteries?
[AusSolar] @tunzafun001: Yes it's also availeble. you can email your address, eletricity bill, date of birth, and phone number to sign up for you
info@AusSolar.au
[jussie2000] @AusSolar: Yes I have panels + battery. Are you helping me switch energy retailers? Is the $1000 for switching energy retailers? What do I have to do to get the $1k
[AusSolar] @jussie2000: We will help you sign up CovaU VPP plan, after you receive the first bill you can apply $1000 VPP credit .
you can email your address, eletricity bill, date of birth, and phone number to sign up for you
info@AusSolar.au
[Wiadro] i have 6.6kw solar already can i add this on?
[AusSolar] Yes, you can email meterbox photos, environment photo around the meter box to check where to put battery.
and an electricity bill , to info@AusSolar.au
[AusSolar] Hi ACT couldn't get that much rebate. its $9499 for ACT
you can email meterbox photos, environment photo around the meter box to check where to put battery.
and an electricity bill , to info@AusSolar.au
[Harshmellow] Yes 3 hours free is a deal but why are you combining it with your product? Are you providing 3 hours free?
[AusSolar] Yes,this covau VPP $1000 rebate + 3 hours free is exclusive to our invitation at the moment.
[cheapaschips] dodgy deal description, telling about the installer, i would avoid
